scene_prompt: Modern family kitchen immediately after an unwise tradeoff. A child has managed to pick up ONE tiny biscuit with a reaching hand, but in stretching over table accidentally knocked over a large carefully decorated cake, now visibly crushed in pieces on floor beside its overturned plate. Child looks regretfully from tiny biscuit to ruined large cake; parent points calmly at the much greater loss. A soft-edged inset attached to child shows earlier moment of reaching for biscuit while elbow tips cake platter over table edge. Main scene larger and clear, no readable text symbols or money. Contrast tiny gain versus huge loss, not merely clumsiness. Safe no sharp shards, no injury; plate is unbroken. Accurate limbs, hand grips biscuit, gravity and grounded cake fragments, stable table. Landscape 3:2, pencil watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no logos letters numbers watermarks.
alt: 孩子只拿到一小塊餅乾，卻因伸手碰倒整個蛋糕，懊悔地看著地上的碎蛋糕；小景顯示先前碰倒盤子的經過。
